[[sn:Arctura, Queen of the Arctic Ocean]][[Arctura, Queen of the Arctic Ocean]] - A regal and serene goddess, embodying the pristine and icy wilderness of the Arctic Ocean. She is associated with the Northern Lights, and is believed to protect the polar bears, walruses, and other Arctic creatures. She is revered as a guardian of the fragile Arctic ecosystem and a symbol of purity and grace.
